claims.statement: Overview declares FPT/GHEC/GHES and describes issues for plans/discussion/work with sub-issue hierarchy. Creation entry points include repository/sub-issue/comment/code/URL and web/Desktop/CLI/APIs/Mobile; overview is capability context, not executable binding or universal authority.

Dependency overview appears unqualified but links explicitly Free-Pro-Team latest; detailed dependency guide declares FPT/GHEC only. Parent page version wildcard must not extend child dependency availability to GHES.

Metadata types/labels/milestones and broad all-metadata-in-Projects statement remain qualified by field availability, organization authority, public/internal visibility and item type. Overview cannot override detailed exclusions.
References and fixes-keyword auto-close summary must retain default-branch and linking-origin constraints from detailed guide. Reference presence or closure does not certify accepted completion.
Subscriptions/dashboard provide latest-comment updates and assignments clarify responsibility, not independently verified freshness/completion or complete inaccessible repository coverage.

Issue templates supported generally while forms and abuse-report/community guideline paragraph are FPT/GHEC conditional. Template presence does not substantiate valid input, adoption or enforced controls.

Mentions target collaborators with repository access; issue-number/title insertion creates relation, assignments and saved replies assist communication. No authority escalation, notification delivery or acknowledgment is guaranteed.

Discussion comparison/shared fragment describes community question/idea conversations; issue conversion is possible, not universal instruction. Actual conversion permission, retained state and recovery require detailed adapter evidence.
Linked next steps/child guides establish review scope only; reading overview does not review linked files, certify published versions or resolve entire outbound web.
